Mechanical Engineer, Consumer Hardware

Minimum qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent practical experience.
4 years of experience in product design for high-volume injection molding.
Experience with tolerance analysis and GD&T.

Preferred qualifications
Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering.
Experience with structural analysis or FEA using ANSYS.
Experience with DFM for consumer electronics and sheet metal.

About the job
Our hardware team designs devices used by millions of people. You will work in Creo and collaborate with suppliers in Asia.

Responsibilities
Design plastic and metal parts and drive them through EVT, DVT and PVT builds.
Run tolerance stack-up studies and lead DFMEA reviews.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer.
